name: Grounded Knowledge Assistant
description: Answers questions from enterprise data, conversationally, with attribution.

name: Document Processing Pipeline
description: Extracts, classifies, or transforms documents/records in bulk, without a human waiting per item.

name: Decision Support
description: Surfaces analysis and recommendations for a human to weigh, without generating a final answer directly consumed by an end user.

name: Conversational Transaction Agent
description: Converses with a user and can also execute actions that mutate a system of record.

name: Autonomous Workflow
description: Executes a multi-step workflow across systems with minimal per-step human checkpoints.

name: Content Generation
description: Drafts or generates net-new content for human review, not grounded question answering.

name: Classification / Extraction Service
description: Applies a fixed label set or extraction schema to incoming items at scale.

name: Analytics Copilot
description: Helps a user query and interpret structured/analytical data conversationally.
